subject: English
question_text: What are the conveniences of Internet technology?
guide_solution: Internet technology facilitates social relations by allowing users to connect and interact with people around the world through web-based social networking services. These platforms provide a cost-effective way to share interests, activities, and personal profiles, making it easier to communicate and build relationships across borders.
source: SSC English 1st-paper Police Lines School & College, Rangpur (Made Easy SQ) 2024

subject: English
question_text: "Face book is the most popular social network." - Explain it.
guide_solution: Facebook's popularity stems from its user-friendly interface and extensive features that allow users to create personal profiles, connect with friends, share multimedia content, and engage in discussions. It offers a wide reach, enabling users to connect with a global audience, which contributes to its status as the leading social network.
source: SSC English 1st-paper Police Lines School & College, Rangpur (Made Easy SQ) 2024

subject: English
question_text: What are some uses of a social network?
guide_solution: Social networks can be used to: • Create and maintain personal profiles. • Connect with others who share similar interests. • Upload and share pictures and multimedia content. • Post blog entries and share updates. • Interact through comments and feedback from friends and other users.
source: SSC English 1st-paper Police Lines School & College, Rangpur (Made Easy SQ) 2024

subject: English
question_text: How can a user take privacy protection measures?
guide_solution: Users can take privacy protection measures by controlling the visibility of their profiles and deciding what information to share. They can restrict the number of visitors or viewers to their profiles and choose specific details that can be made public, ensuring a safer online experience.
source: SSC English 1st-paper Police Lines School & College, Rangpur (Made Easy SQ) 2024

subject: English
question_text: "Social network users feel that they are really live in a global village."− Do you agree with this view? Why/ Why not?
guide_solution: Yes, I agree with this view. Social networks enable instant communication and interaction with people from different cultures and backgrounds, creating a sense of closeness and community. This interconnectedness fosters a feeling of belonging to a larger global community, as users can easily share experiences and ideas across geographical boundaries.
source: SSC English 1st-paper Police Lines School & College, Rangpur (Made Easy SQ) 2024
